sources: Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animal Pack: Husky.gltf (from https://pixeltriks.com). https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A Siberian husky: about 55 cm at the withers, gray and white, a white face with a dark mask, ears up, a thick tail.

A Siberian husky male is 51 to 61 cm tall at the withers, a female 48 to 58 cm; often gray and white, with white paws and legs, facial markings and a white tail tip (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siberian_Husky).
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
